title: chore(pm): an advisory is created in one step, with no collaborator step
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xK4RgsCe9oPGkwFXLYK1jAx)_

Fixes #32178

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 无需操作。本 PR 为 **Tier S**(`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测),当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),通过后由 skills 席位落地。
改了什么:建安全公告只剩一步(`advisory_create`,或第 3 节已允许的 `advisory_report`),不再要求接着加协作者。
`security-findings.md` 第 3 节改一句;中继建/报公告后打印的那行去掉「add whoever works it with advisory_collaborators_add」,只留编号与状态。
`advisory_collaborators_add` 照旧可用,只在维护者要求时走;它的行为、栅栏与自测一概不动。
其余只改描述它为「下一步」的注释,以及钉住旧文字的自测字符串(用例数不变)。

## Maintainer's words (verbatim, session, 2026-11-10)

「创建安全公告不需要指定协作者，立卡修订skills」

## What changes

The skills seat's ruling on the card's open choice: `advisory_collaborators_add` **stays** as an available relay op for a maintainer who asks for it. Only the text that routes a finding seat to it by default goes away. ⛔ No op changes behaviour, ⛔ no gate is added.

### Skill text — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md` L21 (109 → 89 bytes)

```diff
-- 首选中继 `advisory_create` 建草稿公告,再 `advisory_collaborators_add` 带具名账号进公告。
+- 首选中继 `advisory_create` 建草稿公告,一步即成,建时不指定协作者。
```

### Printed rows — `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`

```diff
-/** The row a landed `advisory_report` prints: the id the platform gave it and its state, and the next stroke. Pure. */
+/** The row a landed `advisory_report` prints: the id the platform gave it and its state. Pure. */
-  return `reported ${…id…} · state ${…state…} — add whoever works it with advisory_collaborators_add`;
+  return `reported ${…id…} · state ${…state…}`;
-/** The row a landed `advisory_create` prints: the id the platform gave it and its state, and the next stroke. Pure. */
+/** The row a landed `advisory_create` prints: the id the platform gave it and its state. Pure. */
-  return `created ${…id…} · state ${…state…} — add whoever works it with advisory_collaborators_add`;
+  return `created ${…id…} · state ${…state…}`;
```

### The echo — `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (the advisory-annotation log line)

```diff
-        : `fleet-write: run ${run.id}'s annotation names action ${r.action} ${r.op} → advisory ${r.ghsaId} (the platform's own answer) — add whoever works it with advisory_collaborators_add.`,
+        : `fleet-write: run ${run.id}'s annotation names action ${r.action} ${r.op} → advisory ${r.ghsaId} (the platform's own answer).`,
```

### Docblocks (no logic change)

`ops.mjs`, the executor's five paths:

```diff
- *     a notice annotation name that id, so the seat follows with
- *     `advisory_collaborators_add` — the App is the submitter, so the finding
- *     seat is not a collaborator on its own;
+ *     a notice annotation name that id, and the seat is done — the App is the
+ *     submitter, so the finding seat is not a collaborator on its own, and
+ *     `advisory_collaborators_add` adds one only when a maintainer asks for it;
@@
- *     ever re-sent. The row and a notice annotation name the id, so the seat
- *     follows with `advisory_collaborators_add` exactly as after a report;
+ *     ever re-sent. The row and a notice annotation name the id, and the seat
+ *     is done, exactly as after a report;
```

`dispatch.mjs`, the read-back header and `ADVISORY_ANNOTATED_OPS`:

```diff
- *     `result.annotations.advisories` (`--json`: `advisories`), so the seat
- *     follows with `advisory_collaborators_add` and then reads the advisory
- *     with `advisory_read`. `advisory_collaborators_add`, `advisory_versions`
+ *     `result.annotations.advisories` (`--json`: `advisories`); the seat
+ *     reads the advisory with `advisory_read`, and `advisory_collaborators_add`
+ *     adds a collaborator only when a maintainer asks for it.
+ *     `advisory_collaborators_add`, `advisory_versions`
@@
- * seat needs for its next stroke (`advisory_collaborators_add`): the App files
- * either, so the finding seat is no collaborator until that stroke lands. The message is
+ * seat needs for any later stroke on it (`advisory_read`, or `advisory_collaborators_add`
+ * when a maintainer asks for it): the App files either, so the finding seat is no collaborator on it. The message is
```

`execute.mjs`, the advisory rows header:

```diff
- *     (`relayAdvisoryAnnotationMessage`, `dispatch.mjs`), so the seat follows
- *     with `advisory_collaborators_add`. A 2xx without an id is a FAILED
+ *     (`relayAdvisoryAnnotationMessage`, `dispatch.mjs`), and the seat is done
+ *     (`advisory_collaborators_add` only when a maintainer asks for it). A 2xx without an id is a FAILED
```

Left as they are, agreed with the seat: `ops.mjs` L194 and the `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` L155 comment list the write rows by grant only and never call the op a next step.

## Pins updated

| Pin | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `execute.mjs` battery `REPORTED` | `reported ${GHSA} · state triage — add whoever works it with advisory_collaborators_add` | `reported ${GHSA} · state triage` |
| `execute.mjs` battery `CREATED` | `created ${GHSA} · state draft — add whoever works it with advisory_collaborators_add` | `created ${GHSA} · state draft` |
| `validate.mjs` "the landed rows print…" (surface widened by the seat for this one line) | both tails as above | `reported ${GHSA} · state triage`, `created ${GHSA} · state draft` |
| `dispatch.mjs` "⭐ a filed report" and "⭐ a created draft" | some log line names the id **and** `advisory_collaborators_add` | a log line ends `→ advisory ${GHSA} (the platform's own answer).` **and** no log line names `advisory_collaborators_add` |

Self-test counts, before → after (case names unchanged, no case added or removed):

| Self-test | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `dispatch.mjs --self-test` | 358 cases / 30 batteries | 358 / 30 |
| `execute.mjs --self-test` | 333 / 26 | 333 / 26 |
| `validate.mjs --self-test` | 375 / 19 | 375 / 19 |

Ablation (committed first, then restored with `git checkout`): putting the tail back on the `dispatch.mjs` echo fails 2 of 358 dispatch cases; putting it back on the two `ops.mjs` rows fails 2 of 333 execute cases and 1 of 375 validate cases.

## Sweep

`grep -rn collaborator .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` (SKILL.md, `lanes/security.md` and every other reference): **one hit**, the §3 L21 line above. No other sentence sends a finding seat to `advisory_collaborators_add`.

In `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` and `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`, `whoever works` and `follow(s) with … advisory_collaborators_add` now have **zero hits**. Factual sentences that the seat cannot read an unpublished advisory until it is a collaborator (`dispatch.mjs` read-back header, the "A report has no fallback" comment) do not route anyone and are unchanged.

## Line ratchet

`security-findings.md` shrinks in bytes only (line count unchanged). `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 and is not edited.

## Verification

Head `fda97285`, base `origin/main` `8523ef9ac`, run under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **46 commands**; with the three fleet-write self-tests, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` that makes **51, all exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED** (`turbo run build` of formula, lint and objectql first, for `check:doc-formula-expressions`). ESLint over the four changed `.mjs` files with `pnpm lint`'s flags: exit 0. The full `<cmd> :: exit N` record is in the card thread's gates file.

Not covered by the local list, and left to CI: the 5 type-check lanes and the `Plan Test Core shards` job that `dispatch-gates` names NOT MEASURED. No TypeScript is touched.

## Tier

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test <5 paths>`: **GOVERNED — Tier S** (`.claude/**` ×1; the four `scripts/pm/fleet-write/*.mjs` paths are not on the register).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived mandate (the surface hits none of the 4 declared globs).
- The maintainer's standing order (2026-11-03) waives a mandated tier for card threads; the skills seat runs the contract review of record at the contract-review tier.

Changeset: none, `skip-changeset` label. Nothing here publishes (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
